name: How long does it take to complete a full set of architectural drawings?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a full set of architectural drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary from 4–12 weeks depending on project complexity, revisions, and engineering coordination, with permitting adding another 4–12 weeks in most jurisdictions.
